summary_1line: Bhima, disguised as a cook in Virata’s court, defeats the mighty wrestler Jimuta while Kichaka first becomes infatuated with Draupadi.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhima lifts the massive wrestler Jimuta overhead in the arena and whirls him around before hurling him to the ground as stunned spectators watch.
In the crowded festival arena, two gigantic wrestlers clash like enraged elephants while the king and thousands of spectators roar with excitement.
Kichaka first notices Draupadi in the palace chambers, standing radiant like a goddess while he stares at her in sudden, consuming desire.
